subject: Sponsor promo tranche approval and usage milestones
messages:
From: Elena Torres <elena@launchfoundry.com>
To: neha_kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
Cc: LaunchFoundry Legal <legal@launchfoundry.com>
Date: 2026-08-29T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Promo tranche request + milestone alignment

Hi Neha,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the latency numbers you showed were great and the team is keen to move forward with a pilot. Before we spin up, LaunchFoundry has a simple ask from our side: can Redwood provide a two-tranche promotional credit commitment for our accelerator cohort?

Proposed structure:
- Tranche A: $15k of credits to cover onboarding + first month of activity (expected usage ~500k tokens)
- Tranche B: $10k of credits released upon completion of three milestone checks (integration, SLA baseline, and initial Eval pass)

We can share a short Memorandum of Agreement (MOA) if that helps expedite legal. Also attaching a quick spreadsheet of expected usage.

Would you be able to confirm whether this is possible and what the approval timeline looks like? We’re hoping to onboard early September.

Thanks,
Elena
Director, Partnerships
LaunchFoundry

Attachments: usage_milestones.xlsx (spreadsheet detailing expected cohort activity)

From: neha_kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Torres <elena@launchfoundry.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-29T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Promo tranche request + milestone alignment

Hi Elena — great to hear the demo landed well.

Short answer: yes, we can do a two-tranche promotional allocation for accelerator cohorts, but a couple of internal checks:
1) We need approval from Revenue for the total promotional exposure.
2) Legal will want an MOA with clear milestone definitions and data handling terms (especially for cohort PII).
3) We’ll propose a short usage-safeguard (rate caps / quota limits) to avoid surprise burn during onboarding.

Marissa and Rishi — can you weigh in on: (a) an acceptable promotional cap for this cohort given Q3 incentives, and (b) whether Sales Ops needs a deal record update before we issue tranche A credits?

Elena — if you can send the MOA draft (or confirm you want us to use our promo terms), I’ll kick off approvals this morning.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Enterprise Sales Manager, Redwood Inference

---
Attachment referenced: usage_milestones.xlsx

From: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: neha_kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>, Elena Torres <elena@launchfoundry.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-30T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Promo tranche request + milestone alignment

Neha / Elena — quick note from RevOps:

We can approve up to $25k total promotional exposure for accelerator partners under the current Q3 program. For this specific flow we recommend:
- Tranche A (upfront): $12,500 — issued as credits to the account once HubSpot deal record + PO (if required) is in place.
- Tranche B (milestone): $12,500 — released in one payment once milestones 1–3 are validated by CS.

Operational items:
- Please create/update the HubSpot deal and tag "promo-accelerator-q3".
- We’ll attach a promo terms PDF; legal will need to sign off on any redlines to MOA.

If LaunchFoundry insists on higher upfront coverage we’ll need Exec approval and an SLA exception; that takes 48–72 hours.

Marissa
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: promo_terms_v1.pdf (standard accelerator promo terms)

From: LaunchFoundry Legal <legal@launchfoundry.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, neha_kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>, Elena Torres <elena@launchfoundry.com>
Date: 2026-09-01T11:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Promo tranche request + milestone alignment - MOA draft

Hi all,

Attached is a short MOA that covers:
- Scope of credits and permitted usage (non-production vs production distinctions)
- Data handling assurances (anonymization commitments)
- Liability cap aligned to the promo value
- Milestone acceptance criteria (integration smoke test, latency baseline within 150% of demo, and initial model quality eval pass)

Two quick asks from our side: can Redwood confirm the timeline for tranche B validation (how long CS has to perform acceptance checks) and whether Redwood will provide a temporary support contact for debugging during onboarding?

Thanks,
LF Legal (on behalf of Elena Torres)

Attachments: LF_MOA_v1.docx

From: rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
To: neha_kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, LaunchFoundry Legal <legal@launchfoundry.com>, Elena Torres <elena@launchfoundry.com>
Date: 2026-09-03T14:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Promo tranche request + milestone alignment - Approved with conditions

All — approved. Summary of outcome and action items:

1) Approval: RevOps has approved a $25k promotional allocation split into two tranches as follows: Tranche A $12,500 (upfront), Tranche B $12,500 (upon milestone acceptance).
2) Conditions:
   - Tranche A will be issued after HubSpot deal is created and LaunchFoundry signs the MOA (DocuSign link below).
   - CS will have up to 7 business days to validate milestone checks after the integration handoff. If the milestone validation goes beyond that window, we reserve the right to pause tranche B release pending investigation.
   - Rate caps: 60 RPS per project during onboarding until baseline is established.
3) Support: We will assign a temporary onboarding engineer (Samir Patel) to the pilot and provide a dedicated Slack channel for the cohort.

Next steps (owner):
- Elena: review and e-sign the MOA (LaunchFoundry) — LaunchFoundry Legal inserted the doc.
- Neha: create the HubSpot deal and tag promo-accelerator-q3.
- Marissa: prepare promo credit issuance (Tranche A) pending signed MOA.
- Rishi / CS: standby for integration acceptance.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.net/Member/SigningStart?es=XYZ-DFL-2619
HubSpot: https://redwood.app/hubspot/deal/DFL-2026-019

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
VP, Customer Success & Field Operations
Redwood Inference
